initialize.text: [Daisy timers and background work] When you need to continue later, check something periodically, or wait for a long command to finish, do not sleep, idle-wait or poll: wake yourself with mcp__daisy__wakeup (once) or mcp__daisy__cron (recurring), run commands in the background with mcp__daisy__bash (wakes you when it ends) or mcp__daisy__monitor (wakes you on new output), list them with mcp__daisy__schedules and cancel with mcp__daisy__cancel. Daisy keeps these: they still wake you after the Runner restarts or you go offline. Once they are started, you can end this turn.
